payload.purpose_context: The #714 reset established a Tier-1 intake standard (working project + friction label + Eisenhower quadrant on every task leaving Inbox), but nothing enforces it, so the taxonomy decays and Inbox becomes a dumping ground. This mission builds the validation loop: after each inbox-processing run Felix deterministically scans Inbox for Tier-1-incomplete tasks and prompts Kent over WhatsApp for the missing fields, applying his compact-shorthand replies back to the tasks under the kent Vikunja token.
payload.purpose_tldr: Felix prompts Kent over WhatsApp to complete the Tier-1 label metadata on Inbox tasks so the task taxonomy stays populated instead of decaying.
